decisions.reason: The IMU module gained a page of its own in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and as one module in a modular catalog it costs little to keep while its value is still emerging.

The AC input module has been featured on its own page in both years and was highlighted in a launch announcement, which shows sustained value in an industrial niche that justifies keeping the option alive.
The relay module is only mentioned on the website and its prospects remain uncertain, but carrying a small catalog module costs almost nothing, so the option is worth keeping open.
The LED control module launched only recently and too little is known yet about its value, and keeping a low-cost module in the catalog preserves the option.
The wallbox remote service is a new service with ongoing operating costs and uncertain demand, but it is too early to judge its value, so it stays on the market for now.
